items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I forget his name, but he married Yvonne. ... Haywood, he was married to Yvonne first.

ctx.x: Fred Mergy, this guy that played like Rosolino or better. The were Catholic over there at the University of Detroit. They didn't have any black kids over there. They finally got one, and they made a basketball star one everybody was pressed to have a black athlete. I forget his name, but he married Yvonne.
Was he like seven feet tall?
